ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Corruption in the Trump Administration
ideas.description: This story would investigate the alleged corruption and abuse of power in the Trump administration, including the Trump 'conspiracy' case and other related investigations.
questions: What are the allegations against Trump and his associates?
How far-reaching is the corruption in the Trump administration?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant corruption and abuse of power in the Trump administration. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of these allegations.
